question: Among players taller than 180 cm and born before 1986, identify the one with the highest average heading accuracy between 2010 and 2015, provided their potential score is at least 70. Additionally, exclude any player whose preferred foot is 'left' and whose overall rating never exceeded 80 during that period. Return only the player's name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
  AND p.XCL_125 < '1986-01-01'
  AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  AND pa.XCL_133 >= 70
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
HAVING NOT (pa.XCL_134 = 'left' AND MAX(pa.XCL_132) <= 80)
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_139) DESC
LIMIT 1
